    Vic Schaefer
     is the head women's basketball coach at the University of Texas at Austin, leading the Longhorns since 2020. Under his leadership, the team has achieved significant success, including multiple Elite Eight appearances and a return to the Final Four in 2026. 
    Key Details About Vic Schaefer: 
    • Position: Head Coach, University of Texas.
    • Tenure: 2020–present.
    • Achievements: Two-time National Coach of the Year and four-time SEC Coach of the Year.
    • Previous Roles:
      Head coach at Mississippi State (2012–2020) and Sam Houston State (1990–1997).
       
    This video features an interview with Vic Schaefer, where he discusses his team's success and coaching philosophy:

    Schaefer's coaching staff for the 2025-26 season includes Associate Head Coach Elena Lovato and Assistant Coaches Lindsay Wisdom-Hylton and Blair Schaefer. 
    Note: Texas State University (a different institution) hired Chris Kielsmeier as their new women's basketball coach in March 2026.
